scene: The machine jackpots, spitting transit passes onto the colourful arcade plaza.
picture: Outside the arcade along a single level plaza floor. The player in his blue cap and orange cardigan stands centre holding glowing tickets with his wooden cane. On the far left, a red bicycle rickshaw waits. To the right, a striped water taxi floats by a dock. Up high on the far right sits a glass funicular car.
shown: A red bicycle rickshaw parked waiting on the far left of the plaza
A striped water taxi moored at a wooden pier on the right
A steep glass funicular car resting on tracks up high at far right

variants.scene: Glowing transit tickets flutter into your hands beneath neon arcade signs by the water.
Prize passes fan out in your grip as evening settles along the boardwalk.
You pocket lucky tickets, still humming {tune} above the gentle harbor waves.
